_about: Public-domain Frederick Temple (1821-1902), Headmaster of Rugby, Bishop of Exeter and London, and Archbishop of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: the three series of Sermons Preached in Rugby School Chapel (1858-1869), The Present Relations of Science to Religion (1860) and his Bampton Lectures, The Relations between Religion and Science (1884). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 69 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

temple-rugby-sermons-1: Sermons preached in Rugby School Chapel, in 1858, 1859, 1860 (London : Macmillan, 1870)
temple-rugby-sermons-2: Sermons Preached in Rugby School Chapel in 1862-1867 (Macmillan, 1871)
temple-rugby-sermons-3: Sermons Preached in Rugby School Chapel in 1867-1869 (Macmillan, 1872)
temple-science-religion-sermon-1860: The present relations of science to religion : a sermon preached on Act Sunday, July 1, 1860, before the University of Oxford, during the meeting of the British Association (Oxford : J.H. and Jas. Parker, 1860)
temple-religion-science-1884: The relations between religion and science : eight lectures preached before the University of Oxford in the year 1884 (New York : Macmillan and Co., 1884)

_excluded.temple-essays-and-reviews: his essay 'The Education of the World' in Essays and Reviews (1860), a many-author volume
